Go, now.|Anakin Skywalker and Obi-Wan Kenobi during their [[Mission to Fondor (Separatist Crisis)|mission to Fondor]]|<ref name="Star Wars Adventures 1: Hunt the Sun Runner">''[[Star Wars Adventures 1: Hunt the Sun Runner]]''</ref>}}
'''Proton grenades''', also known as '''proton charges''', were small packets of explosives that were either thrown by hand, loaded into mortars, and sometimes loaded into a ship's bombing bay. These grenades were activated by flipping a small switch on one side, and exploded on contact.

==Description==
Proton grenades were handheld [[Explosive charge/Legends|explosives]] built around a [[proton core]], which was a smaller version of the [[Proton-scattering energy warhead|warhead]] used in [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedoes]]. A proton grenade was more effective than a [[Detonite charge/Legends|detonite charge]], and contained almost the same destructive power as a [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonator]].<ref name="EGWT" />

Proton grenades were originally designed to breach the [[Hull/Legends|hulls]] of [[Starship/Legends|starships]] during boarding operations. They were also used in large-scale demolitions projects. The grenade could be affixed to a surface via a [[magnetic plate]] at the bottom. The casing was comprised of prestressed metal and surrounded a [[Proton charge|shaped proton charge]]. The shaped charged funnelled the full force of the explosion towards the magnetic plate, and the blast was capable punching a hole through up to a [[Meter/Legends|meter]] and a half of materials such as [[Permacite/Legends|permacite]]. When used during a boarding operation, the charge blasted through [[Armor/Legends|armor]] plating, exposing the interior of the ship to hard [[Vacuum/Legends|vacuum]]. An [[Electromagnetic pulse/Legends|electromagnetic pulse]] disabled electronic devices within a range of twenty meters, including [[Computer/Legends|computers]], [[Droid/Legends|droids]], and [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]].<ref name="EGWT" />

Activating a proton grenade was a two-stage process that was intended to prevent accidental detonation. The first step consisted of twisting the arming mechanism, which primed a [[Battery/Legends|battery]] to send an electrical charge to the proton core. The second step was depressing the activation plunger which started the [[timer]]. The timer could be set for any time up to twenty [[Standard minute/Legends|minutes]], and the grenade could be disarmed at any point by pressing the twist plunger release.<ref name="EGWT" />

==History==
In [[23 BBY/Legends|23 BBY]], before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], 18-year-old [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] used a [[Hypermatter reactor/Legends|hypermatter reactor]]-planted proton grenade to destroy the [[False Sun Runner|counterfeit]] ''[[Sun Runner]]'' [[Transport/Legends|transport]] fabricated by [[Groodo]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] in his [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]-foiled scheme to destroy the [[Fondor Shipyards/Legends|Fondor Shipyards]].<ref name="Star Wars Adventures 1: Hunt the Sun Runner" />

Proton grenades were used mostly by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]], planetary defense forces, and smugglers. However, they were also occasionally used by the official military, ([[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]), but the [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonator]] was generally preferred. [[Zero-G assault stormtrooper|Imperial spacetroopers]] were known to use this weapon to breach ship hulls.

During the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and his commandos used several [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn]] [[7-PrG proton grenade/Legends|7-PrGs]] to destroy the [[Endor shield generator bunker]].<ref name="EGWT" />
